{{Top|leg}}
'''Thomen''' was an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] individual, who served aboard the [[Alderaanian gunship]] [[Aegis (Alderaanian gunship)|''Aegis'']] as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]]. the crew of the gunship, including Thomen, became [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Caline Metara]].<ref name="Razor's Edge">''[[Razor's Edge]]''</ref>
